paragraphs.text: The early Magic: The Gathering sets came with a rulebook written by Richard Garfield . These were included only with starter decks . Larger versions could be found in gift packages .
The following editions of starter deck inserts are known:
Alpha (32 pages) — black and white cover with Bog Wraith .
Beta / Unlimited — same cover, minor text revisions
Revised — black and white cover with Shivan Dragon
As of 2010, an official Basic Rulebook is available on magic.wizards.com . For advanced players, there are the Comprehensive Rules .
